metadata.title: कंवर आदिवासी भैंसे का मांस खाते थे या सिर्फ़ बलि प्रथा थी?  Kanwar were beef eaters?।Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
Kawar tribe of Chhattisgarh lives mainly in Korba district of Chhattisgarh. There is no conclusive study about how this tribe came to be here, but it has been assumed that this tribe is not native to the place, and migrated from somewhere and settled in the jungles and hills in this area. There is also a suggestion that Kawars are actually descendants of the Kauravas from the Mahabharat era, but most anthropologists believe that it's just a myth. There are indications that this tribe was a beef eater in the past, but now it has stopped sacrifice and eating beef.
